card_sentences: SAMPLE Two friends in Queens started baking lentil crisps in a shared kitchen in 2023. They wanted a salty snack with ingredients you can read out loud.
allergen_line_verbatim: SAMPLE CONTAINS: WHEAT, MILK, EGGS, SOY, SESAME, PEANUTS, TREE NUTS (ALMONDS, CASHEWS, PECANS, WALNUTS), FISH (ANCHOVY) AND CRUSTACEAN SHELLFISH (SHRIMP, CRAB).
may_contain_verbatim: SAMPLE MADE ON SHARED EQUIPMENT WITH PRODUCTS THAT CONTAIN MUSTARD, CELERY, LUPIN AND OTHER TREE NUTS. MAY CONTAIN TRACES.
allergen_line_verbatim_2: SAMPLE CONTAINS: WHEAT, MILK, EGGS, SOY, SESAME, PEANUTS, TREE NUTS (HAZELNUTS, CASHEWS, PECANS, WALNUTS), FISH (ANCHOVY) AND CRUSTACEAN SHELLFISH (SHRIMP, CRAB).
